items.title: Product of the Day — Cigarette Lighter Knife
items.content_text:
The Cigarette Lighter Knife combines two essential tools into one sleek, portable package. This hybrid device features a functioning cigarette lighter integrated into the handle of a compact folding knife. The flame source doubles as a makeshift cutting tool, allowing users to ignite fires or slice through tough materials with equal ease.

When closed, the lighter-knife combo measures only 6 inches long and weighs less than 12 ounces. Its ergonomic design makes it comfortable to carry in a pocket or purse.

items.title: Cat Fact of the Day
items.content_text:
The term “puss” is the root of the principal word for “cat” in the Romanian term pisica and the root of secondary words in Lithuanian (puz) and Low German puus. Some scholars suggest that “puss” could be imitative of the hissing sound used to get a cat’s attention. As a slang word for the female pudenda, it could be associated with the connotation of a cat being soft, warm, and fuzzy.

Picture: Cataas (https://cataas.com/)
